name: cursor-skill-studio
description: Stable consolidated pack for the full skill lifecycle: writing, auditing, and maintaining skills and packs. Renamed from cursor-skill-creator in 0.3.0 and finalized as the canonical skill-studio surface in 1.0.0 per ADR-0005. Ships three explicit-only bundled skills — skill-studio-write (greenfield authoring, distillation, pack scaffolding, external intake, Claude-plugin adaptation, eval loop), skill-studio-audit (single-skill compliance audit, improvement recommendations, installed portfolio audit, deep repo-first-party overlap audit), and skill-studio-maintain (root-skill and pack releases, registry alignment, bundled-skill artifact edits, promotion/demotion, maturity classification, install verification) — together with authoring helper subagents and audit subagents (overlap clusterer, architecture checker, consolidation advisor). The deprecated cursor-skill-creator-workflow bundled skill was removed in 1.1.0; users mid-upgrade should re-sync to drop stale install files.
author: felipeblassioli

lite.description: Installs the bundled authoring workflow, helper subagents, and audit subagents (overlap clusterer, architecture checker, consolidation advisor) without persistent project rules.

strict.description: Same as lite plus project-only guidance for disciplined intake, decomposition, and evaluation loops when authoring or auditing packs and bundled skills.

notes: Strict installs add persistent project guidance for adapting source material into bundled skills and packs.
User installs skip rules because Cursor user rules are managed in settings rather than a ~/.cursor/rules directory.
Pack-scoped: not listed in skill-registry.json. Invoke explicitly via /skill-studio-write.
Consolidates writing-cursor-skills, create-skill-from-refs, create-cursor-pack-from-refs, external-skill-intake, and claude-plugin-to-cursor-pack per ADR-0005.
Pack-scoped: not listed in skill-registry.json. Invoke explicitly via /skill-studio-audit.
Consolidates audit-skill-for-cursor, improving-agent-artifacts, and the packs/skill-consistency-auditor bundled workflow per ADR-0005.
Pack-scoped: not listed in skill-registry.json. Invoke explicitly via /skill-studio-maintain.
Consolidates skills/personal-skill-maintainer and skills/personal-pack-maintainer per ADR-0005.
